While the broader paper describes CRISPR knockouts in mouse and human models, those are analyzed via RNA-seq and ChIP-seq, not the mass spectrometry dataset provided in the PRIDE metadata.

base_candidates_ranked.reason: The experiment uses tandem affinity purification (TAP) followed by HPLC-ESI-tandem MS on an LTQ Orbitrap Velos Pro. While no explicit labeling is mentioned, the goal is to identify interactors across different MGA constructs (full-length vs fragments), which typically follows a DDA-LFQ or spectral counting approach for relative abundance/presence.

workflow: Tandem affinity purification of MGA-interacting proteins and mass spectrometry
The resulting tryptic peptides were analyzed by HPLC-ESI-tandem mass spectrometry on a Thermo Fisher LTQ Orbitrap Velos Pro mass spectrometer
